tasks.title: Start the selected project and publish a verified live app link

states.label: Authorize project and check actual process state

properties.name: Every app link names a ready owned live instance
properties.expression: An authenticated project owner may launch a project with both current accepted gates and a valid source/ make run contract; only actual readiness and page success for its live source revision publish an Open app link and a chat launch result; the app remains running after the launch request completes
properties.formula: AG atom("An authenticated project owner may launch a project with both current accepted gates and a valid source/ make run contract; only actual readiness and page success for its live source revision publish an Open app link and a chat launch result; the app remains running after the launch request completes")

properties.name: Every application supports the same Make targets
properties.expression: Every generated HTTP app provides source/Makefile with build, run, stop, test, check, clean and serve targets. run is foreground; serve aliases run; stop affects only the project-owned app. LeanFM invokes these fixed targets rather than per-app shell commands and reports missing targets as actionable unsupported-contract failures. make check runs the app's actual proportional verification; no unsupported target is claimed successful.
properties.formula: AG atom("Every generated HTTP app provides source/Makefile with build, run, stop, test, check, clean and serve targets. run is foreground; serve aliases run; stop affects only the project-owned app. LeanFM invokes these fixed targets rather than per-app shell commands and reports missing targets as actionable unsupported-contract failures. make check runs the app's actual proportional verification; no unsupported target is claimed successful.")

tasks.title: Inspect live application state

states.label: Authorize project and check actual process state

properties.name: Lifecycle remains explicit and project scoped
properties.expression: The UI reports stopped, starting, running, stale or failed from actual owned-process state; repeated Start returns the existing current instance; a changed source revision is visibly stale and requires restart; browser and chat can request start without a paid model call for the launch itself
properties.formula: AG atom("The UI reports stopped, starting, running, stale or failed from actual owned-process state; repeated Start returns the existing current instance; a changed source revision is visibly stale and requires restart; browser and chat can request start without a paid model call for the launch itself")

tasks.title: Stop only this project's application instance

states.label: Authorize project and check actual process state

properties.name: Stopping is scoped and idempotent
properties.expression: Stop closes the named owned instance and removes its ready link; repeated Stop is harmless; project deletion and LeanFM shutdown clean up owned runtime children; one instance exists per project and at most four instances exist per server
properties.formula: AG atom("Stop closes the named owned instance and removes its ready link; repeated Stop is harmless; project deletion and LeanFM shutdown clean up owned runtime children; one instance exists per project and at most four instances exist per server")

provenance.prompt: I want LeanFM to launch the app being built and post a link; make targets must be supported and uniform for all apps
provenance.question: Which scoped lifecycle messages and Make contract provide a persistent, verified, browser-reachable app?
provenance.reducer: validateRequirementSpec; validateRequirementProtoFile; tasksJson from the same RequirementSpec
provenance.unit: messages, states and transitions per project lifecycle task
